purpose: Define a point-in-time champion/candidate pool surface that can be used for fixed-condition TRADEX ranking challenger tests without lookahead.

date_semantics.as_of_date: The latest date/time at which all candidate membership, features, scores, and ranks are known.
date_semantics.candidate_date: The trading date for which the candidate pool is generated.
date_semantics.feature_cutoff_date: The maximum market-data date allowed in feature construction. Must be <= as_of_date and <= candidate_date unless explicitly documented as previous confirmed data.
date_semantics.ranking_snapshot_date: The date represented by the candidate/ranking snapshot. Must not be after the signal decision date unless the test explicitly uses execution-date availability and records the lag.
date_semantics.future_return_horizon_dates: Outcome dates used only for evaluation and never for candidate membership, score, rank, or topK membership.

forbidden_feature_inputs: top/bottom labels derived from future outcome
nearest-next ranking snapshot when ranking_date > decision_date
no_lookahead_validation_rules: candidate_date <= as_of_date unless delayed publication is explicitly recorded
ranking/candidate pool match must use candidate_date, as_of_date, execution_date, or nearest-prior point-in-time date only
nearest-next date alignment is forbidden for ranking challenger tests
no_future_label_used must be true for all score/rank/topK inputs
evaluation-only fields must be physically or logically excluded from score/rank/topK construction

decision_labels.ready: A safe point-in-time candidate pool can be generated from existing sources without changing champion logic.
decision_labels.reconstructable_with_contract_gap: Reconstruction is feasible, but missing contract fields must be added going forward.
decision_labels.blocked_missing_sources: Existing artifacts do not contain enough information to reconstruct the pool.
decision_labels.blocked_unsafe_inference: Reconstruction would require inferring or changing champion scoring logic.
decision_labels.blocked_future_label_risk: Available source depends on future returns or unsafe dates.
